description: Submit music work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound.

inputSchema.description: Generate music. time_signature uses one of "2", "3", "4", "6" (for 4/4 submit "4", not "4/4"). Use instrumental=true with no lyrics, or instrumental=false with non-empty lyrics. Validate the final plan before submission.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_rights.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_safety.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

bpm.description: Integer tempo from30 through300 BPM; default120.

description.description: Music description, 3–2000 characters after trim and newline normalization. Do not include unsupported control characters.
examples: Original 15-second playful electro-pop instrumental, punchy first beat and a clean ending.

duration_seconds.description: Exactly one of 10,15,30,60,120 seconds; default30. A 15-second ad can request15.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

instrumental.description: Set true for instrumental BGM and omit lyrics. Defaults false, which requires lyrics.

key_scale.description: Case-sensitive note plus Major or Minor. Sharps are supported; flat spellings are not accepted.

language.description: Lyrics language code; unlike Voice, Music uses short codes such as ko.

lyrics.description: Lyrics up to 4096 characters. Required and non-empty for instrumental=false; omit or send an empty string for instrumental=true.

time_signature.description: API meter code: "2", "3", "4", or "6" only. For 4/4 time submit "4". Never send "4/4", "3/4" or "6/8" in this field; musical wording may appear in description.

name: music_create
title: Create music
